founders.description: Zero-added-sugar, fibre-rich prebiotic instant coffee sweetened with monk fruit, sold D2C, through quick commerce and in its own stores.

founders.research_notes: Website note: unverified (no official domain confirmed)

founders.name: ARC
founders.description: ARC X1, an India-first-priced handheld gaming console running its own OwlOS on Qualcomm silicon.

founders.lvlup_program: CPG Fund by category (hardware is listed). Pre-revenue, so First Check is the realistic route until shipments start.
founders.personal_detail: Jadhav's framing that "access should not determine how deeply someone experiences gaming." The site publishes developer diaries.

founders.name: Protein Pantry
founders.description: Clean-label, high-protein frozen foods and pantry staples, made in-house.
founders.location: Delhi NCR, with a 10,000+ sq ft facility in Noida (Inc42; Ascendants says Delhi-based).
founders.incorporation: India. Listed as Slappin Foods Private Limited on [IPO Platform](https://www.ipoplatform.com/startup-business-funding/slappin-foods-private-limited-sfpl/103299). Treat the entity name as third-party data.
founders.stage_signal: Launched; founded Nov 2025. Rs 9 Cr seed led by Sharrp Ventures (22 Sep 2026). Inc42 reports about 30,000 customers, a Rs 7 Cr revenue run rate and 25% monthly growth.
founders.lvlup_program: CPG Fund. A Rs 7 Cr run rate is roughly $65K+ per month, an estimate.
founders.personal_detail: The angel list includes consumer-brand operators such as Varun Alagh and Saurabh Munjal; ask what they pushed for on quick-commerce food.
founders.research_notes: Website note: unverified (sells on its D2C site, Blinkit, FirstClub and Flipkart Minutes per Ascendants) launched about 10 months ago, so older than 60 days, but still early.

founders.name: Aignosis
founders.description: AI-assisted autism and developmental screening delivered through a "clinic-in-clinic" model for paediatricians.
founders.stage_signal: Early traction; founded 2024. Rs 4 Cr seed (about $417K) from Antler, Nikhil Kamath, Varun Dua and IIMA Ventures (1–3 Oct 2026). Over 8,000 screenings; deployed in 20+ government primary health centres in Rajasthan.
founders.personal_detail: The government primary-health-centre rollout in Rajasthan, and the partnerships with Mankind Pharma and Apollo Shines.

founders.name: Procurio

founders.public_contact: The founder's contact page offers direct email and WhatsApp for investment, partnership and press: https://procurio.in/chandru
founders.personal_detail: His LinkedIn post that opens "Sourcing from India is hard"; ask how he picked aerospace and defence as beachhead verticals.

founders.name: Factrika

founders.personal_detail: The 90% fill rate across multiple manufacturing clusters.

founders.name: Demoverse
founders.description: AI design tools that let brands involve consumers directly in designing products (B2B2C).
founders.stage_signal: Founded 2026. About seven closed trials with Indian brands; a consumer app is in development. $600K pre-seed led by Lumikai (22 Sep 2026).

founders.personal_detail: The round came through Lumikai's "Pixels" programme. Ask what the seven brand trials showed about conversion.

founders.name: Climitra

founders.location: New Delhi, India (Third Derivative and Inc42).
